_written: 2026-10-09, BEFORE computing any return from the Coin Metrics data (only coverage was inspected: data/metadata/coinmetrics_coverage.csv).
data: coinmetrics/data @f1a36afb (community CSVs, CC BY-NC 4.0 - research use only; commercial use would need a licence). 139 assets with PriceUSD; includes some dead assets (survivorship REDUCED, not removed: the community set is curated by Coin Metrics).
universe: point-in-time at each weekly rebalance (Wednesday close, UTC daily data): non-stablecoin, non-wrapped, non-duplicate-deployment assets (exclusion list in code, by name, set before results) with >= 90 days of price and market cap; top 30 by CapMrktCurUSD; reported spot volume >= $1M (30-day median) when volume is available
execution: weights set with data through day t (UTC close), held from close t+1 (one-day lag) for 7 days
costs: 30 bps per unit turnover (alt spot/perp taker + spread, ASSUMPTION); stress 60 bps
contamination_note: TEST overlaps data already viewed for BTC/ETH (CT1) and 21 perps 2025-26 (CT1 transfer) and the researcher's general knowledge of the 2023-25 crypto market; cross-sectional signals on alts are a different object, but TEST is labelled PARTIALLY CONTAMINATED.

H16a_XS_MOM.portfolio: long top third / short bottom third, equal weight, dollar neutral
H16a_XS_MOM.source: Liu, Tsyvinski & Wu (2022) Common risk factors in cryptocurrency, JF

H16c_XS_MVRV.portfolio: as above, assets with MVRV only

H16d_XS_NETGROWTH.portfolio: as above, assets with addresses only
H16d_XS_NETGROWTH.source: network-adoption factor (Liu & Tsyvinski 2021; Cong et al. 2022)

H16e_BTC_MVRV_TIMING.signal: BTC long when MVRV below its trailing 4-year median, flat otherwise (and the reverse-rank neighbour: scale = clip(2 - MVRV/median, 0, 1))
H16e_BTC_MVRV_TIMING.periods: TRAIN 2013-2019, VALIDATION 2020-21, OOS 2022-23; 2024-26 BTC is USED (reported only as contaminated)

gates.TRAIN: net Sharpe >= 0.5 AND >= 2/3 neighbours net > 0 (XS factors: long-short spread net of costs)
gates.TEST: single look: net Sharpe > 0 at 30 bps AND > 0 at 60 bps
gates.H16e: TRAIN >= 0.5 with residual vs B&H >= 0.3; VALIDATION >= 0.3 & resid > 0; OOS >= 0.3 & resid > 0

status_ceiling: Crypto XS factors are capped at PROMISING_BUT_UNVALIDATED because of curated-universe survivorship and partial TEST contamination.
